name: Canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB signaling from TLRs and TNFRs
rationale: Members converge on IKK/NIK-driven NF-kappaB activation and its ubiquitin-based regulation downstream of TLRs, TNFR1, CD40 and TNFSF receptors; unlike confusables they include the non-canonical NIK branch, TNFR1 signaling and IRF3/7 control but not the TAK1-JNK/p38 or NOD branches.

name: Telomere recombination and mitotic recombination-intermediate resolution
rationale: Members concern recombination/replication-based telomere maintenance (D-loops, t-circles, capping, break-induced replication) together with resolution of mitotic recombination intermediates and intra-S checkpoint, which the confusables lack.

qualifier: with cardiomyocyte proliferation control and endocardium
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation and ventricular wall morphogenesis, including endocardium
rationale: Members cover myocardial (compact, trabecular, septal) morphogenesis and regulation of cardiomyocyte proliferation/differentiation, plus endocardium and coronary vasculogenesis that distinguish it from stress/heart-tube confusables.

name: Endocytic recycling and plasma membrane-endosome protein traffic
rationale: Members concern traffic between plasma membrane, endosomes and secretory route, with receptor/endocytic recycling and endosome organization distinguishing it from Golgi-endosome-lysosome confusables.

name: Telomere capping protecting ends from recombination and NHEJ
rationale: Members concern capping/packaging of telomere ends and blocking recombination, NHEJ and telomerase at telomeres, unlike confusables centred on telomere replication or telomerase recruitment.

name: Myoblast and satellite cell regulation in skeletal muscle regeneration
rationale: All members regulate skeletal myoblast/satellite cell proliferation, differentiation and fusion, with satellite-cell activation and regeneration distinguishing it from myogenesis-programme confusables.

name: B cell development and homeostasis with BCR signaling
rationale: Members are B cell development, proliferation, survival and immune-module signatures, and the BCR signaling pathways (BTK, CD22, RAS) distinguish it from plasma/memory B and T-cell-mixed confusables.

name: Mitosis and cytokinesis with APC/C-controlled mitotic exit
rationale: Members span mitotic chromosome condensation, cohesion, spindle, nuclear envelope and cytokinesis events, and the APC/C ubiquitin-ligase control of mitotic exit is what all confusables lack.

qualifier: with repression of splicing and decay
name: mRNA stabilization with repression of splicing and decay
rationale: Members concern post-transcriptional mRNA control by stabilizing transcripts and inhibiting splicing, processing and decay, unlike confusables centred on miRNA silencing or 3'-end processing and decay.

name: Phospholipid synthesis with phosphatidylglycerol and cardiolipin remodeling
rationale: Members are de novo synthesis of PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin via CDP-DAG and CDP-choline, with PG/CL remodeling and lipid transfer distinguishing it from remodeling, scrambling and catabolism confusables.

name: Sphingolipid and glycosphingolipid synthesis and lysosomal catabolism
rationale: Members cover ceramide, sphingomyelin and ganglioside synthesis, transport and lysosomal degradation, distinguishing it from GPI/glucosamine and amide-metabolism confusables.

name: Notch and Hedgehog signaling via regulated proteolytic processing
rationale: Members concern Notch receptor cleavage and NICD transcription, Hedgehog autoprocessing/GLI processing and other intramembrane proteolysis (p75NTR, amyloid), combining the Notch and Hh arms that confusables carry only separately or replace with Wnt.

name: Stress hormone-driven fear, drinking and ethanol behavior
rationale: Members concern behavioral responses to stress, CRH and corticosterone, with drinking and ethanol behaviors distinguishing it from HPA-secretion and general-behavior confusables.

name: Transcriptional restraint of myeloid progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members concern transcriptional programs (RUNX1, VENTX, granulopoiesis) in myeloid progenitors and negative regulation of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation, unlike confusables with positive differentiation and mature monocyte trafficking.

name: Platelet activation and aggregation via soluble-agonist GPCRs
rationale: Members concern platelet activation, degranulation, aggregation and coagulation, with ADP, thrombin, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signaling distinguishing it from adhesion/integrin-based confusables.

name: Amino acid catabolism, threonine and histidine
rationale: Members are amino/organic acid metabolism terms whose specific content is threonine and histidine catabolism, distinguishing it from confusables focused on aromatic, proline, glycine or sulfur amino acids.

name: Cardiac muscle adaptation, growth and contractility
rationale: Members concern cardiomyocyte proliferation, hypertrophy, regeneration and survival plus positive regulation of cardiac contraction and heart rate, distinguishing it from vascular smooth muscle and calcineurin-centred confusables.

name: Notch target-gene transcription in Th2 and pancreatic development
rationale: Members concern NOTCH2-4 intracellular-domain transcriptional output and its regulation, with Th2 and pancreatic bud contexts distinguishing it from NOTCH1-activation and mutant confusables.

core: Eicosanoid synthesis by P450 and lipoxygenase
name: P450 and lipoxygenase eicosanoid synthesis and its inherited defects
rationale: Members concern HETE, EET and hepoxilin synthesis by cytochrome P450 and lipoxygenases, with inherited defects (CYP1B1, TBXAS1, SLCO2A1) and P450/12-LOX branches distinguishing it from leukotriene/omega-oxidation confusables.

name: Sensory processing, social and vocal learning behavior
rationale: Members concern sensory-driven (touch, auditory, visual) behavior, social and vocal learning and related limbic/striatal development, unlike motor/locomotor and cerebellar confusables.

name: Endocardial cushion EMT forming cardiac valves and septa
rationale: Members concern endocardial cushion EMT and valve morphogenesis, with atrial, membranous and muscular septum morphogenesis distinguishing it from confusables.

name: TCR and BCR signaling with CD28 costimulation and coinhibition
rationale: Members concern TCR and BCR proximal signaling with CD28, CTLA4 and BTLA co-regulation, combining T and B receptor arms that confusables carry only one of.

name: Mitochondrial protein import and processing, with calcium uptake
rationale: Members concern mitochondrial protein targeting, import, processing and degradation, with SMDT1 processing and mitochondrial calcium import distinguishing it from cristae/fusion confusables.

name: Ventricular myocardium and endocardium morphogenesis with coronary vasculogenesis
rationale: Members concern ventricular compact/trabecular myocardium growth, endocardium and coronary vessel formation, distinguishing it from valve/aorta confusables and from one lacking endocardial and coronary terms.

name: ER unfolded protein response via IRE1 and PERK translational control
rationale: Members concern ER-stress UPR, stress-regulated translation initiation and ER-stress apoptosis, with IRE1/PERK regulation distinguishing it from HRI/GCN2, mitochondrial and ATF6 confusables.
